not_testable.level2_depth: no book history available; live snapshots only
not_testable.time_and_sales: last 1,000 prints only; footprint history not subscribed; bar-delta proxy used

results.rules: Daily vote >= 1: at least one more daily setup says long than short (or vice versa).
Daily vote >= 2: two or more daily setups agree on the same day.
Daily vote >= 3: three or more daily setups agree on the same day.

Vetted vote >= 1: only setups positive in train and validation (d_rsi2_pullback, d_inside_day_break, n_d_ibs, n_d_turnaround_tuesday, n2_d_bollinger_low, n2_d_seven_day_low, n2_d_turn_of_month, n2_d_gap_down_reversal).
Any intraday setup, first signal of the session (reference, no confluence).
Any intraday setup whose signal has 2 of 3 confluences (volume profile, order-flow proxy, daily 200-day trend).
Any intraday setup whose signal has all 3 confluences.
